name: Ahornbahn
kurzbeschreibung: Austria's largest reversible aerial tramway whisks 160 passengers from Mayrhofen up to the 1,965 m Ahorn plateau in the Zillertal.
dauer: Half-day to full-day trip (cable car ascent approx. 6.5 minutes)
preis: Ascent & descent adults approx. €40.00; Zillertal Activcard valid
oeffnungszeiten: Mid-May to late October daily 07:30/08:30 to 17:00; winter season December to April
beschreibung:
Overview

The Ahornbahn in Mayrhofen in the upper Zillertal is Austria's largest reversible aerial tramway and a masterpiece of modern cableway engineering. Its two distinctive bright-red large-capacity cabins carry up to 160 passengers each, gliding across a vertical difference of over 1,300 meters in just six and a half minutes to reach the 1,965-meter Ahorn plateau. Built in 2006 by renowned ropeway manufacturer Doppelmayr to replace a historic 1960s lift, it serves as the gateway to Mount Ahorn. Upon arriving at the top, visitors are welcomed by a 360-degree panorama encompassing the glaciated Zillertal Alps, Tux Prealps, and High Alps Nature Park Zillertal Alps. In summer, diverse hiking trails and wildlife experiences beckon, while winter brings wide carving slopes.

Route & Requirements

Surrounding the mountain station lies a gently rolling plateau with diverse recreational opportunities for all generations. The stroller-friendly and barrier-free "Genießerrundweg Ahorn" takes about an hour to walk around scenic Lake Ahorn and along Ahornbach stream, featuring comfortable wooden loungers and shaded resting spots. Educational stations share insights into local alpine flora and fauna. A standout attraction is the Adlerbühne Ahorn at 2,000 meters – Europe's highest bird of prey sanctuary –, presenting daily flight demonstrations with eagles, falcons, and eagle owls. For mountaineers, the station serves as the classic trailhead for climbing Ahornspitze (2,973 m, approx. 6 hours round trip, requiring surefootedness and freedom from vertigo). Easy walking shoes suffice on the plateau, while ankle-high hiking boots are essential for high-alpine summit routes.

Visit & Arrival

Ahornbahn operates in summer from mid-May to late October daily from 07:30/08:30 to 17:00; winter runs from December to April. Adult return tickets cost approx. €40.00; children enjoy discounts, and the Zillertal Activcard includes one daily return ride. The valley station is located on the southern edge of Mayrhofen, with paid parking on site. Train travelers take the Zillertalbahn to Mayrhofen and reach the cable car station by local bus or a 15-minute walk.

Tips

Attend the impressive birds of prey demonstration at Adlerbühne at 14:00. Afterwards, visit the architecturally striking "Café-Bistro Freiraum" at the mountain station, featuring a cantilevered glass viewing platform with panoramic views down into the Zillertal.
